scope: Minimal verification requested by the user; no broad regression rerun.

syntax.method: Node vm.Script parse of the final JavaScript sources

targeted_tests.coverage: Second-finger spell tap; compatibility click deduplication; swipe, scroll, cancel and release-outside handling; mouse and keyboard activation; independent pointer release preserving the joystick.
Rest choice model: authoritative combat gate, PvP, fractional wait, safe areas, death, active-rest duplicate prevention and server-provided descriptions.

code_review: The rest choice dialog closes immediately after sending a valid rest request; no active-rest progress panel remains.
Pressing the rest launcher while resting sends rest_cancel.
Player rendering uses the authoritative owner rest state for the above-character progress, meditation pose, blue aura and nine rising mana droplets.
Effects stop when the authoritative rest state clears. Animal forms retain their appearance.
Canvas state is saved and restored; particle storage does not grow.
not_run: Physical phone multitouch and visual check
Full server and JavaScript regression suites
deployment: Local source changes and release packages only; no push or live deployment.
